name: MiniMax H3 · first & last frame

video_from_keyframes.note: H3's native first/last-frame mode: the first keyframe is frame 0 and, if there is a second, it is the last frame of the clip. It does NOT place keys at arbitrary positions -- that is the multiframe-reference graph, a different preset -- so a timeline with three or more keys is refused (too_many_inputs) instead of silently losing the middle ones.

description: MiniMax H3 animates from a start image, optionally to an end image, with sound. Runs on your GPU; nothing leaves this machine.

detachWhenAbsent.note: One image is image-to-video. The second LoadImage is unplugged rather than fed a placeholder, so it never runs.

keyframes.note: Image 1 is the first frame; image 2, if present, is the last frame.

frames.note: H3 latents want 17k+5 frames at 24 fps (MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo snaps to that grid itself; rounding here lets the bridge say by how much). Floored at 73 (~3 s). The trained range is ~124-362 frames (5-15 s); shorter still renders.

prompt.note: No preamble: the user's own words are the prompt, as in the official ComfyUI template. The images are read by the node, not described in text.

$FRAMES.note: output length; the bridge rounds up to 17k+5

$CHECKPOINT.note: chosen from requires.checkpoints, never by the caller

int8_convrot.note: The variant the official ComfyUI template ships. On the reference machine it lives in S:\Antigravity\CODEX\Minimax and is reached through extra_models_config.yaml.

models.note: nvfp4 has no native kernels on Ampere, so on a 3090 it is emulated -- the same situation as Qwen 2511's fp8mixed, which measured 8.6x slower. It runs once per prompt, not per step, but measure it before believing it is fine.
Always on: 8 steps instead of the template's 20. On a 3090 the difference is minutes per clip.

compatibility.note: First end-to-end run, 2026-09-14, RTX 3090 / ComfyUI 0.35.1, cold (nothing loaded): 5 s clip from one 1280x720 image -> 1280x736, 124 frames + AAC audio, 516 s total. Sampling 6:04 for 8 steps (~40-45 s/step after a 60 s first step). The rest is the nvfp4 text encoder (ComfyUI log: 'emulated ops: ... nvfp4') and the two VAEs. int8_tensorwise and convrot_w4a4 run natively.

notes: Rebuilt by hand from Comfy-Org/workflow_templates templates/video_minimax_h3_i2v.json (2026-09-14): the same loaders, sampler (res_multistep, simple), guider and decode, flattened out of its subgraph and without its UI helpers (ResolutionSelector, ComfyMathExpression, ComfySwitchNode), which the bridge does not need.
Output size follows the start image scaled to 0.9 MP in steps of 32, as in the official template. The last frame is cover-cropped to that size by the node itself.
Priority 50, below LTX's 100: the editor's keyframe timeline keeps resolving to LTX unless a caller pins this preset with templateId.
